items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Hospital Java Patching Rush Meets New AI Product Push
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) disclosed new Java security vulnerabilities affecting US hospital systems as health networks rushed to apply patches in recent days. Hospital IT teams across multiple US regions have initiated accelerated maintenance windows to secure clinical and back office systems running Java-based applications. items.title: Oracle says OpenAI contract is fully funded, addresses market financing scrutiny
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) stated that it has secured the capital needed to fulfill its cloud infrastructure contract with OpenAI, describing itself as the first hyperscaler fully funded for the current artificial intelligence investment cycle. According to the company, a final capital raise earlier this month completed the financing framework previously outlined at its investor day, including vendor financing arrangements.
